cuda_jl.candidate_unit: Distinct evaluated complete source-program snapshots; not five measurement trials, source entry definitions or specialization launches.
cuda_jl.work_item_mapping: 128threads/4warps; 2thread QK groups, 2wideQK/4wideV, warp/cachepage schedule, shared logits and crosswarp outputreduction. Utilities256threads. KA flattened group→(head,sequence), JACC logicalindex→thread/group.
cuda_jl.data_layout: Original packed key [page,head,D/4,token16,component4], dense value [page,head,D,token16], query[sequence,head,D], serialized exact hostcanonical Float32 bits.
CUDA_backend_extensions: Device fast exp/division; normal libdevice math
cuda_jl.support_boundary: FP32 block16/equal query-KV heads, three named cases D32/64/128; lengths1/15/16/33/129/257, ALiBi/tails/repeated pages/constantV. Original BF16 actualsm70 deviceassert; no BF16target baseline. Sparse, partitioned, GQA, other D/defaultCLI sizes not evaluated. Original GPU math unchanged; faulty CPU packed-key checker independently replaced.
cuda_jl.host_device_boundary: Sum3 direct attention launches and context completion only; allocations, initializers, readbacks and independentCPUgate outsideROI. Original CLI funcAttrsetup excluded symmetrically.
